children: , the healthcare and pharmaceutical company, reported positive Phase 3 results for Caplyta in adults with bipolar I mania. Shares rose about 1.5% to $273.18 at 10.55am ET time on Thursday morning.

The trial found a 4.8-point greater reduction in mania symptoms than placebo after three weeks, with improvement evident by Day 3. J&J gained Caplyta through its $14.6 billion purchase of Intra-Cellular Therapies. A mania approval could give doctors another reason to prescribe a drug already used for bipolar depression.

The valuation leaves little room for a slow payoff. At $273.18, J&J trades 41.08% above its $193.64 GF Value estimate. The trial strengthens the case for Caplyta, but investors still need a regulatory approval, a useful label and enough prescriptions to justify the premium.

title: J&J Gains 1.7% as Caplyta Opens a Mania Expansion Path
